title: SNARY: A High-Performance and Generic SmartNIC-accelerated Retrieval System
problem: Retrieval workloads in data centers create CPU bottlenecks and network latency. Existing systems lack a generic, efficient mechanism to offload diverse retrieval operations to SmartNIC hardware.
motivation: SmartNIC acceleration enables processing retrieval queries at the network edge, reducing CPU overhead and improving end-to-end latency for data-intensive applications.
method: SNARY offloads retrieval query execution to the SmartNIC data plane using programmable packet processing. It implements efficient in-memory data structures and query logic on SmartNIC hardware while exposing a generic interface supporting diverse retrieval patterns and workload types without custom hardware modification.
key_novelty: Generic SmartNIC-accelerated architecture that unifies diverse retrieval workloads without requiring custom hardware redesign.
contributions: SmartNIC-based retrieval system with direct data plane query execution
Generic abstraction layer supporting multiple retrieval patterns and data structures
High-performance retrieval with significant speedup over CPU-based systems
